## Checks

- [ ] All checks in CONTRIBUTING.md ("Setup and checks") pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated; a bug fix includes a test that fails without it
- [ ] Docs updated (README tables, error codes, env vars, API docs) where behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, keys, `.env` files or build output in the diff
- [ ] Money math in integer units, addresses compared case-sensitively
- [ ] I understand and can explain every line, including AI-assisted code
